attributes.action: Banning private displays fireworks, for the sake of animals and certain people
attributes.additional_details: Its about private firework displays, you dont know when its going to happen, so can not prepare for it, I think it should be organised displays only, because you know what time it will be, where its taking place,so you can prepare,not just some random bangs not knowing when, plus its not just about the animals, its about Veterans that suffer withPTSD, that fireworks might trigger them Its the same with the people who will be triggered by loud noise, dont forget about those people. Just ban them.
attributes.background: bring rules like the gun laws, you need a licence, and there are very strict rules to owning a gun, apply it to Fireworks, or just ban private displays altogether, just organised displays only as you will know the time you can prepare, at the moment an 18 year can basically buy a bomb if they want

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
